svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut four 30 mm lengths of 30 x 30 x 3 angle; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat leg (goes on the panel frame's back lip): two 4.5 mm holes,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 mm from one end, 11 and 23 mm from the back of the upright leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: one 6.6 mm hole at mid-length (15 mm), 16.5 mm out

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the face that sits on the lip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All four clips are the same. On each side one goes at the panel's high

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge (post), one at its low edge (strut); the drilled end lines up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the panel edge, the flat leg points outward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: M4 bolts through the clip and the frame lip, nut inside the frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the lip through the clip; keep clear of the glass and cells.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the panel you buy has a back lip at least 12 mm wide;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: if not, stop and see open question 3 in the plan.
